content: Homage to the glorious Vajrasattva!For one who wishes to perform the three-part torma offering:The ingredients are:"Include parched rice, sesame seeds, rice porridge, flowers, and water; add bean porridge in abundance, along with oil cakes and other such foods," as stated in the Vajra-ḍāka; there are three types: the torma offering for the directional guardians, the general torma for the spirits, and the torma for the obstructors. The first of these is: sprinkle scented water with OṀ VAJRA YAKṢA HŪṂ to purify and expel the obstructors, then generate splendor with OṀ VAJRA JVALA ANALA HANA DAHA PACA MATHA BHAÑJA RAṆA HŪṂ PHAṬ.Contemplate emptiness with OṂ SVABHĀVA. From the state of emptiness, contemplate vessels that are vast and expansive, formed from precious substances and the like. Recite OṂ ĀROLĪKE SARVA TATHĀGATA PĀDĀBANDHENĀTE OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂ PHAṬ SVĀHĀ three times, and contemplate that the torma substances have become a complete collection of the five objects of desire. Then, to invite the directional guardians, hold the vajra and bell.Guardians of the directions, protectors of the world, possessing power,Great kings of sacred vows, of compassion and skillful means,Gods, ṛṣis, pretas, rākṣasas, and nāgas,Vidyādhara kings, and the lords of the yakṣas.Manifesting in the individual forms of each,Guardians of the directions and protectors of the world, I beseech you to be present.As I invite you for the sake of the flourishing of the teachings,I pray you come to accept these offerings for the benefit of beings.*Oṃ ehyehi daśa dik lokapāla saparivāra svāhā*—with this, invite them.The giving of the torma:O host of Vajra-holding deities of the east, together with your retinues,I pray you accept these tormas offered to you.Lords of fire, Yama, the southwest, and the rākṣasas,Lords of water, wind, and wealth,The powerful deity who is the lord of spirits,The sun, moon, and Great Brahmā above,All the gods and the nāgas of the earth below,And the mountain deities together with the pure assemblies—May these tormas, offered to each of you individually,Be accepted with great joy,And having returned to dwell well in your respective directions,Together with your children, spouses, friends, and kin,Together with your households, armies, and retinues,Along with flowers, scents, and tormas, and ointments,Partake of these and accept them well,And grant that the fruits of my activities may be realized.Oṃ indrāye svāhā, oṃ agnaye, oṃ yamaye, oṃ nairṛtyaye, oṃ varuṇaye, oṃ vāyave, oṃ kuberaye, oṃ īśānaye, oṃ īśvarāya, oṃ ūrdhva-brahmāye, oṃ sūrya-grahaye adhipataye, oṃ candra-nakṣatra adhipataye, oṃ pṛthivībhyo, oṃ asurebhyaḥ, nāgebhyaḥ, gṛhṇedaṃ, oṃ arghaṃ svāhā. And with the words: Namaḥ sarva-tathāgatebhyaḥ viśvamukhebhyaḥ, sarvathā khaṃ utgate spharaṇa imaṃ gagana-khaṃ, gṛhṇedaṃ baliṃ svāhā, Offer the bali.Please make us and our retinue free from obstacles, And grant us the supreme attainments of enlightened activity. Having said this, the praise is as follows:Divine Lord, Holder of the Vajra,King of the gods and master of spirits,To you and your assembly of spirits in the east,I offer, praise, and prostrate.Fire, the god who consumes the offering,King of sages and master of spirits,To you and your assembly of fire deities in the southeast,I offer, praise, and prostrate.Yama, the god who holds the club,King of the Mamos and master of spirits,To you and your assembly of spirits in the south,I offer, praise, and prostrate.Nirṛti, the god who is devoid of truth,King of the Rākṣasas and master of spirits,To you and your division and assembly of spirits in the southwest,I offer, praise, and prostrate.Varuṇa, the god who holds the lasso,King of the Nāgas and master of spirits,To you and your assembly of spirits in the west,I offer, praise, and prostrate.Vāyu, the god who sustains the life-force,King of the Vidyādharas and master of spirits,To you and your assembly of spirits in the northwest,I offer, praise, and prostrate.Yakṣa who holds a club in your hand,King who protects wealth and master of spirits,To you and your assembly of spirits in the north,I offer, praise, and prostrate.Powerful deity who leads,Lord of Bhūtas and master of spirits,To you and your assembly of spirits in the northeast,I offer, praise, and prostrate.Great Brahmā and the great planets of the sun and moon above,Great Brahmā, master of spirits,To you and your assembly of planets and constellations,I offer, praise, and prostrate.To the subterranean nāgas and the deities of the earth,To the great-handed holders of the earth,To all the assemblies who know the samaya,I offer, praise, and prostrate.(With these words, offer praise.)For us yogis and our retinues,Grant health, longevity, and power,Glory, renown, and good fortune,And may we obtain all vast enjoyments.Bestow upon me the accomplishments of the activities,Such as pacifying, increasing, and so forth.You who possess the samaya, protect me,And act as my companion in achieving all accomplishments.May the world be at peace and harvests be bountiful,May grain increase and the Dharma flourish,May all that is virtuous and auspicious arise,And may every heartfelt desire be fulfilled.With these words, entrust the enlightened activity, and contemplate that all siddhis without exception are obtained. Second, offer to all elemental spirits; having blessed them as before, invite all elemental spirits, headed by the special gods and nāgas, as follows:Devas, nāgas, yakṣas, mahoragas, and snakes,Garuḍas, birds, and kumbhāṇḍas,Gandharvas, rākṣasas, and all classes of demons,And all those who dwell upon the earth, possessed of miraculous powers.Together with your wives, children, and retinues,I place my knees upon the ground,And with palms joined, I offer this prayer;Please listen and come here to provide your protection.Oṃ deva, nāga, gandharva, asura, garuḍa, kiṃnara, mahoraga, manuṣya, amanuṣya, etyehi. Having recited this, offer seats and offerings as before. Place them under oath, Contemplate that they are pleased by the bali, And at the end of [the names] deva and so forth,Perform the offering with *Namaḥ sarva tathāgata*, and so forth:Whatever spirits dwell in the supreme abodes,In the groves of joy and the dwellings of the gods,And in the eastern and western mountains and the mansions of the sun and moon,And those who dwell upon all the mountains,And those who dwell especially on the islands of jewels,And all the rivers and the confluences of rivers,And the lakes, ponds, pools, and riverbanks,And those who dwell in the trickling mountain streams,And in villages, cattle-pens, roads, and deserted cities,And in empty houses and the abodes of the gods,And those who dwell in temples and reliquaries,And those who dwell in the abodes of the ascetics and in the elephant stalls,And those who dwell in the royal treasuries,And at the lanes, the three-way junctions, and the crossroads,And those who dwell upon the highways and at the foot of solitary trees,And those who dwell in the great charnel grounds and the great forests,And those who dwell among lions, bears, and beasts of prey,And those who dwell in the great, terrifying wildernesses,And those who dwell upon the supreme continents,Those who dwell in the charnel grounds of Mount Meru,Having become thoroughly delighted and overjoyed,With garlands, flowers, scents, and incense,Respectfully offer praises, tormas, and lamps.Please partake of these and accept them well,And grant that the fruits of my activities may be realized.Having dedicated it thus, make the following supplication: "Please pacify all obstacles for the benefactor and others, whether arising from past karma or from immediate conditions, and please ensure that all intentions, such as the increase of prosperity, are fulfilled in accordance with the Dharma." Having thus prayed for the desired objectives, say "Oṃ sarva bhūta gaccha" to request their departure.Third, one should make an offering to the obstructors, While possessing the pride of the wrathful deity oneself.Namo! By the truth of the Buddha’s word, the truth of the Dharma’s word, and the truth of the Sangha’s word, And by the blessings of the guhyamantra, dhāraṇī-mantra, vidyā-mantra, mudrā, and samādhi, And by the truth that the nature of reality is utterly pure, And by the blessings of the infallible cause and effect of conditioned phenomena, May all those of whatever class of demon or obstructor that harm and injure all sentient beings, In an instant, arrive here to accept this bali.Oṃ guṃ ka re guṃ ka re svāhā, oṃ pi tsi pi tsi svāhā, oṃ guṃ guṃ svāhā, sarva vighna svāhā (recite this at the end).Invite them with Oṃ e hye hi, and offer with Gṛ hne daṃ arghaṃ svāhā (recite this at the end of Oṃ guṃ ka re).(Give the offering with) Namaḥ sarva (then offer again and contemplate that they are satisfied).Those who wander in the night,The bhūtas and the piśācas,The rākṣasas who eat raw flesh,And sentient beings of every kind:Dwellers in trees and sprawling branches,With food, meat, alcohol, and radishes,And rice, grain, and many fruits—Be satisfied by this ritual offering,Pacify all thoughts of causing harm,And generate a mind of benefitToward us from this day forward;For previously you have not received such offerings.Today I make this offering to you;Even if there are past karmic debts,Be satisfied by this ritual offering,And by the command of the Three Jewels,If through the fault of broken samaya,You should cause harm, it is not well;O lord of obstacles, depart!For those of sweet seeds,Sweet fruits will grow,From seeds that are bitter,Bitter fruits will also grow.Take your own body as an example,And do not cause harm to others.OṀ SARVA VIGHNA GACCHA.Having sent them away with these words, expel them with the mantra of SUMBHA NI or the Amṛtakuṇḍalin. Dedicate the virtue toward buddhahood.The condensed Three-Portion Torma Offering, composed by the Lama Jetsün Drakpa Gyaltsen, is complete. Virtue.
